veilcore/schema/pathogen/v1.title: One pathogen or viroid test of one sample (HLVd, a virus, a bacterium), as a laboratory reports it. Slot 0 is the call: 1 detected, 0 not detected. Slot 1 is the cycle threshold (Ct) when the method gives one, times 100. Which target, which method and which sample are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2), not here. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).

veilcore/schema/genetic-match/v1.title: A laboratory's comparison of one sample with one other record by a stated genotyping method. Slot 0 is the call: 1 the genotypes match, 0 they do not. Slot 1 is the number of markers compared, slot 2 the number that differ. Which records were compared (by their proof codes), the method and the panel are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2); no genotype is in either. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).

veilcore/schema/lineage-check/v1.title: A laboratory's check that one sample is consistent with descent from one or two named parents by a stated genotyping method. Slot 0 is the call: 1 consistent, 0 excluded. Slot 1 is the number of markers compared, slots 2 and 3 the conflicts with the first and the second parent named. Which records were compared (by their proof codes), the method and the panel are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2); no genotype is in either. Consistent with descent is not proof of descent. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).

veilcore/schema/dna-mark/v1.title: A laboratory's record that it looked for a DNA mark in a sample. Slot 0 is the call: 1 the mark was found, 0 it was not. The mark's sequence is never here: the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2) carries only a salted SHA-256 of it, and the sequence is shown only when a dispute needs it. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).

veilcore/schema/lab-retraction/v1.title: A laboratory withdraws one of its own earlier results. Slot 0 is always 1. Which result is withdrawn, and why, are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2). The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).

veilcore/schema/seed-quality/v1.title: Seed quality, as on a seed analysis certificate. Each number is the percentage times 100 (98.50 % is 9850). Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
